suggestedCaseNotes.annotated_case_note: During morning medication round, prisoner appeared visibly tense and pacing near the hatch. <mark>Prisoner became agitated</mark> following a verbal altercation with another prisoner and required repeated staff prompts to de-escalate.

amendments.annotated_text: During association he approached staff to raise a minor concern about his cell temperature, <mark>remained polite and easy to reason with throughout</mark>, and <mark>thanked staff for looking into it</mark>.

suggestedCaseNotes.annotated_case_note: On association, staff observed increased frustration after a dispute about queue order. <mark>Staff observed raised voice and refusal to return to cell</mark> until spoken to by a senior officer.
At evening meal the prisoner looked withdrawn and avoided interaction with peers. <mark>Prisoner appeared unsettled</mark> but accepted guidance and did not escalate further.

amendments.annotated_text: Spoke at length with the wing officer about his upcoming release plan and <mark>appeared calm and cooperative throughout the conversation</mark>, engaging well with the questions asked of him.
Follow-up check the next day found no further issues to report and he remained settled for the rest of the shift.

suggestedCaseNotes.type: Key Worker Activity / Key Worker Session
suggestedCaseNotes.annotated_case_note: I conducted a key worker session with Darren. We discussed his health, family contact, meaningful activity and plans for the future. He said he was <mark>feeling safe on the wing</mark> and wanted to continue engaging with education.
Good effort seen in ESOL this morning with finding the purpose of texts. Darren completed the activity independently and supported another learner when asked.
